messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "binding to mu-opioid receptors"
set: ["binding to mu-opioid receptors", "binding to the alpha-2-delta subunit of calcium channels in nerve cells", "activating two gut hormone receptors", "blocking alpha-1 receptors in the prostate and bladder neck", "blocking the effect of adrenaline and noradrenaline on beta-1 receptors in your heart", "nerve cells to communicate", "body's ability to clear cholesterol", "allowing blood to flow more smoothly", "increases air flow to the lungs", "improves how the body responds to insulin", "long-term use returns blood volume to normal", "normalizing chemical signals nerves send to each other", "increasing the supply of blood to the heart", "blood vessels offer less resistance to blood flow", "helps prevent certain bacteria from becoming resistant to amoxicillin", "causes high levels of serotonin to build up in your body"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
